name: Adobe Experience Manager
description: Create, edit, search, publish pages and content fragments, and search for assets in Adobe Experience Manager — simply by describing what you need. Instead of navigating the user interface, write what to do in plain language: update a hero banner, find pages about a campaign, schedule content for launch, or find assets for the experience you are authoring. All changes respect your AEM permissions. Work faster, reduce repetitive tasks, and stay focused on what matters most — your content.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adobe Experience Manager to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adobe Experience Manager to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.adobeaemcloud.com/adobe/mcp/aem. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adobe Experience Manager MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe Experience Manager provides these MCP tools: list-aem-environments, lookup-api-spec, read-api, write-api, and delete-api.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adobe Experience Manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adobe Experience Manager in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Adobe Experience Manager MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe Experience Manager requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adobe Experience Manager is developed by Adobe. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
